title: SuperTag resource deletion
description: Response to DELETE on a Tag, Role, Permission Set, Context Set, Workspace, or Surface Account, or to the same request with dryRun=true. A resource still in use is refused with a Status failure instead; its details.references list every reference.

action.description: Tags, Roles, and Surface Accounts retire and keep their records; sets and Workspaces are deleted.

removed.description: Human-readable descriptions of configuration removed along with the resource.

notes.description: Human-readable effects outside the Control Plane's configuration.
